title: Machine learning builds a glycosyltransferase prognostic signature in colorectal cancer
summary: GARS outperformed clinicopathological features for prognosis, supported by nested cross-validation and four independent external cohorts. It is a bioinformatic prognostic signature without wet-lab validation, and the review is based on the abstract and Methods and Results.
ai_technology: Seven machine learning algorithms combined to build a glycosyltransferase-associated risk signature (GARS) from bulk and single-cell RNA-seq
organization: Zhongnan Hospital of Wuhan University, China

evidence.tested: Nested cross-validation plus four independent external cohorts
evidence.unknown: Bioinformatic prognostic signature, no wet-lab; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Seven ML algorithms build glycosyltransferase-associated prognostic signature (GARS) in colorectal cancer
